perf.summary: FixedArray is already near-optimal; the only note is that `Length = sizeof(TS)/sizeof(T)` divides per access — for power-of-two element sizes this is a constant per specialization and folds, so no action unless Length is hot.
perf.currentCost: `sizeof(TS)/sizeof(T)` is a compile-time-constant ratio per (TS,T) specialization, so Burst already folds it to an immediate. CheckIndexInRange is Conditional and elided in release. Buffer is AggressiveInlined and pins per access.
perf.proposedChange: No change required; structure is correct. If profiling ever shows Buffer's per-access `fixed` pin as hot, it could be hoisted by callers, but within this struct it is already inlined and the pin is free for a non-moving struct field under Burst.
perf.rationale: Confirming the file is already optimal avoids inventing work; the sizeof ratio and Conditional checks are the right patterns.
